assessment.diversity_evidence: All six stories share the same missing-book problem, fruitless search, adult retrieving the book from a high shelf, and shared reading ending. The only meaningful branch is whether Mina explicitly returns the atlas and chooses to help (s000058, s000023, s000017) or the text says Ms Alvarez saved it for her (s000014, s000028, s000036); wording changes such as “saw” versus “spotted” do not create new plots.
